correctness.rationale: For the exact published 18 triangular facets of the regular 9-vertex torus, independently enumerated 27 edges, 27 graph 3-cliques and nine nonfacial triangle cycles. Contracted an actual spanning tree to 19 integer cycle coordinates; independently computed Smith normal form of the 18x19 relation matrix with 17 unit diagonal invariants and 2 zeros, giving H1(Z)=Z² without torsion. Independently evaluated the two exact cocycles against every face and all nonfacial triangles, finding three each of (0,-1),(1,0),(-1,1), all primitive nonzero, so systolic edge length is 3. Exhausted all 9! vertex permutations and found exactly 108 automorphisms, with induced H1 image order 12 and kernel order 9. The proof is for labeled finite simplicial edge lengths only, not metric systoles.
residual_risks: Integral Smith pivots and cocycle evaluations are essential: field ranks alone would not establish primitive integral classes.
